bound.walk: copy printed untemplated GET paths from the official MET Aviationforecast swagger; skip templated {format} paths and GET operations that print required query parameters; skip /aw and /iga because they print required icao or wmoheader; native ids are the last printed path segment; access_path is swagger origin + printed basePath + path; do not invent dataset ids or icao/wmoheader filters
bound.how: pda ingest --source aviationforecast --limit 10. The official MET Aviationforecast swagger prints 6 untemplated GET paths that have a last-segment id and no required query parameter. The adapter copies those paths. GET uses the printed /locations collection with no invented query filters. Forecast paths print required icao or wmoheader so they stay unused for listing and fetch. This is not Metalerts (--source met), not Locationforecast (--source locationforecast), not Tafmetar (--source tafmetar), not Sigmets (open PR 159), and not Udir Grep (open PR 161).
